answer: Cross-epoch pulse continuity: each identity’s signed activity rhythm is scored per epoch and matched against its prior atlas of behaviour. An identity whose pulse pattern shifts sharply must replay that shift across later epochs; a raven flag marks accounts whose rhythm was synthesized only at registration. Enforcement: mismatches lower the identity’s match weight, and re-earning it requires sustained, costly participation across at least three epochs, so a sybil farm pays continuous per-identity upkeep rather than a one-time entry cost.
